title: fix(service-automation)!: registration refuses a flow with no start node, so POST /automation answers 400 at the save
body:
Part of #32142

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: follow-up #32288 — the skill already teaches a start node first, but the hand-written trigger tables (`content/docs/automation/flows.mdx`, `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx`, `plugin-endpoints.mdx`, `declarative-endpoints.mdx`) and the `packages/client/src/index.ts` trigger docblocks still promise `422 FLOW_NO_START_NODE` for a stored start-less flow, which now answers the trigger doors `404` (contract review 6772843445, F1).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:流程注册新增一条检查,顶层 `nodes` 里没有 `start` 节点的流程直接拒收;`POST /api/v1/automation` 保存这种流程回 `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`,消息点名缺的 start 节点和修法,不再先回 200、等到触发时才回 422 `FLOW_NO_START_NODE`。
- 为什么改:没有 start 节点的流程永远跑不起来,作者(包括 AI 作者)被告知保存成功,直到自动化一直不触发才发现。按 Prime Directive 12,这种元数据应在编写时就被响亮拒收。
- 风险与回滚:已存储的无 start 流程开机时不再挂载,但开机照常完成,元数据读取照旧返回原行,并附 `registration: refused` 与原因;元数据保存门仍可保存编写中的草稿。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:① `packages/services/service-automation/src/flow-registration-checks.ts`(`validateStartNode`,以及它在 `registrationChecks` 中排第一);② `src/flow-refused-registration-read.integration.test.ts` 末尾新 describe(存量行的开机、读取、草稿保存三条路径);③ `packages/qa/dogfood/test/flow-node-config-values-at-registration.dogfood.test.ts` 的两个新用例(HTTP 门与包加载)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run src/flow-registration-checks.test.ts`,预期 10 个用例全绿,其中 `status draft: refused` 一条说明草稿同样被拒。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`flow-registration-checks.ts`**: a new check, `validateStartNode`, first in `registrationChecks`. It refuses a flow whose top-level `nodes` hold no `type: 'start'` member, an empty list included, with a message that opens `Flow 'NAME' rejected: the flow's top-level` nodes `hold no` start `node (found N node(s), of type ...)`, says every trigger and explicit run would be refused with `FLOW_NO_START_NODE`, and names the cure (add a start node and an edge from it to the first step). Its stored-pass site is `flows[0].nodes`, so `os migrate meta --stored` lists the row as a `registerFlow` TODO there with no second change (the one list `registerFlow` and the stored pass share).
- It is a plain module function called straight from the list, not a new engine member, so `engine.ts` is untouched (it reads no engine state). `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts` is untouched too: `POST /` already serves any `registerFlow` refusal as `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` through `flowDefinitionRefusal`.
- **Status-agnostic, as every other registration check is.** A `draft` flow is enabled in this engine (only `obsolete` / `invalid` are disabled), so a start-less draft fails its first run exactly as an `active` one does. I followed the other checks (`validateApiTriggerSecret`, `validateDecisionModes`, `validateNodeConfigKeys`, `validateFlowExpressions`), none of which reads `status`.
- **Only the flow's own graph.** A start node inside a region body does not count; a region is entered at its single entry node and `validateControlFlow` judges it.

### What a flow ALREADY STORED with no start node does now (measured, pinned)

| Path | Before | Now |
|:---|:---|:---|
| Boot (`kernel:ready` bind, boot pull) | registered, enabled, never fired; a run answered 422 | the boot completes; the bind warns, naming the flow and the reason, and records the refusal; every other flow arms as before |
| Read (`GET /meta/flow/NAME`, list) | `registration: registered` | the stored row is served unchanged (it does not vanish), beside `registration: refused` and the engine's words |
| Metadata save door (draft kept mid-edit) | saved, registered | still saved (the save door does not run registration checks); the mutation sync records the same refusal |
| `os migrate meta --stored` | not listed | listed as a `registerFlow` TODO at `flows[0].nodes` |
| `POST` / `PUT /api/v1/automation` | 200 | 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED`, nothing registered |

No product choice was needed to keep stored rows loadable: the refused-registration record (`getFlowRegistration` → `refused`) every other registration check already uses carries them.

## Tests

- `src/flow-registration-checks.test.ts`, a new top-level describe: refused in `active`, `draft` and `obsolete`, the message naming the missing node, `FLOW_NO_START_NODE` and the cure, nothing armed; an empty `nodes` list; a start node only inside a loop body; the control (the same flow with a start node registers in every status).
- `src/canonicalize-stored-flow.test.ts`: one row in the #23317 `CASES` table, so the stored-pass listing (`flows[0].nodes`, in the check's words), the `registerFlow` refusal, the on-protocol control and the listing-equals-refusal agreement all cover it.
- `src/flow-refused-registration-read.integration.test.ts`, a new top-level describe on the real composition (ObjectKernel + ObjectQL metadata protocol over driver-sql `:memory:` + the real automation plugin): the boot reaches `running` with a start-less stored row, the row is not armed, the read serves it as stored beside the refusal; the metadata save door keeps a start-less `draft` and the read reports it refused.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/flow-node-config-values-at-registration.dogfood.test.ts` (the registration-doors harness): `POST /api/v1/automation` with a start-less flow answers status `400`, `error.code` `VALIDATION_FAILED`, the message opening with the start-node refusal, and `GET /automation/NAME` answers 404; a packaged start-less flow: the boot completes, the flow is not registered and the boot log names it with the refusal.
- **Flipped pins, each made to bear weight** (repo-wide sweep of `FLOW_NO_START_NODE` and start-less `registerFlow` fixtures; the other hits are transport tests on fakes, untouched): `engine.test.ts` "should fail when flow has no start node" now asserts the registration refusal and that a run of the name finds no flow; the #9378 "all three exits" pin's third exit now asserts the refusal and that the run still carries no `status`; the #9415 "which refusal" pin asserts the refusal names `FLOW_NO_START_NODE` and nothing is armed; `flow-label-on-result.test.ts` asserts the refusal and that the unregistered refusal carries no label.

## Acceptance notes

- **Remainder of the card, not in this PR:** "unknown positions, queues and channels at least warn at save". The save answer has no advisory channel to reuse: `POST /automation` answers `deps.success(servedFlowDefinition(...))`, and the engine's advisory pass only logs. Landing it needs a warnings slot on the save answer (a response-shape decision) and a lookup of positions, queues and notify channels at save, so this PR is `Part of`.
- **Located:** the refusal locates in prose (`the flow's top-level nodes`), and `stored-pass` sites carry the path `flows[0].nodes`; the HTTP answer's `details.fields[]` addresses `(body)`, as every non-Zod registration refusal does (`flowDefinitionRefusal` does not read the engine's sites). A field path on the wire would need `registerFlow` to throw its sites, an `engine.ts` change.
- **Now unreachable by any door:** `AutomationEngine.execute()`'s `FLOW_NO_START_NODE` exit and the retry copy in `dag-traversal.ts` are defensive only, and the comment above the `execute()` exit ("Registration accepts a flow with no start ... is not dead code") is now false. `engine.ts` is outside this card's surface; noted for the lane that owns it.
- **Docs drift:** the platform checklist recipe `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/automation.json` authors a start-less `qa_no_start_node` through publish to reach the trigger table's 422 row, and says that a publish-time check landing makes that step 4xx. After this PR that row is reachable only by a fixture that seeds past registration; the recipe needs re-reading by its owner.
- `Clause-②:` is written `no (narrowing)` where the claim wrote `no`: `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` refuses `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` beside a `Clause-②:` line with no `(narrowing)` arm as a contradiction (`narrowed-without-arm`). The kind is the claim's.
